name: Julia Brenner
met_context: School friend from Munich (same Abitur class)
summary: UX designer and old school friend who now does usability testing at a Hamburg agency and offered to review UI mockups.

notes.text: Jules (Julia Brenner) - friend from school in Munich, we were in the same Abi class. She's a UX designer at Kontora, a fintech in Berlin, mostly mobile banking apps. Said she'd look over my UI mockups whenever I want, she loves giving design feedback. Big into ceramics lately.
Call with Jules. She left Kontora and now works at Feldwerk, a design agency in Hamburg, as senior UX designer. Doing a lot of usability testing now. Offer to review my app UI still stands.
